Title: Label packs — Lily Design System

Description: Ready-made labels for Lily's data grid, kanban board, calendar, Gantt chart and filter in 64 locales: how to load a pack in every framework, and why 63 of them are still unreviewed machine drafts.

# Label packs

Lily ships no English defaults, so the grid-like helpers used to need a hundred-odd strings written and translated by every app. A label pack is that work done once, for 64 locales.

## What a pack holds

One JSON file per locale in [`shared/label-packs/`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/shared/label-packs) holds the `labels` for `data-grid`, `kanban-board`, `calendar`, `gantt-chart` and `filter` — names for controls, live-region announcements, export headers, the filter's operator names. About 185 strings each. Strings that take values are templates with `&#123;placeholders&#125;`; wording that depends on a value (ascending or descending, collapsed or expanded, a dependency type) is an object keyed by that value.

## Loading a pack

- **Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, HTML, Web Components** — `labelsFor("data-grid", pack)` returns a ready `labels`.
- **Nunjucks** — `nunjucksLabelsFor("kanban-board", pack)` returns `&#123; macro, client &#125;`: pass `macro` as the macro's `labels` and `client` as the client's `labels` option.
- **Blazor** — `LabelPack.FromJson(json).ToDataGridLabels()`, and `ToKanbanLabels()`, `ToCalendarLabels()`, `ToGanttLabels()`, `ToFilterLabels()` in their packages.

A key a pack lacks leaves that label unset — the control is unnamed, and the helper says so in development — rather than showing text from another language. Labels that depend on how a locale writes dates (weekday names, period titles, the Gantt column label) are not in a pack: build them with `Intl`.

## Read this before shipping a pack

Only English is reviewed. The other 63 packs are machine drafts, marked `"reviewed": false` in the file, and a native speaker should check them — screen-reader names and announcements most of all — before a product relies on them. Welsh, which most deserves a careful read, is among the drafts. The packs are not yet published as an npm or NuGet package; copy the file you need from the repository.

## The 64 locales

ar, bg, bh, bn, cs, cy, da, de, el, en, es, et, eu, fa, fi, fr, ga, gd, gu, ha, he, hi, hr, hu, id, is, it, ja, jv, km, kn, ko, kw, lb, lo, lt, lv, mr, ms, mt, nb, nl, pa, pcm, pl, pt, ro, ru, sco, sk, sl, sv, sw, ta, te, th, tl, tr, uk, ur, vi, wuu, yue and zh — each as `<code>-001`. (Bhojpuri keeps the requested tag `bh`; its ISO code is `bho`.)

The full contract is in the [label-packs specification](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/spec/label-packs/index.md).
